title: Mexican Cheese Fondue
description: A few spoonfuls of salsa stirred into the pot give this fondue a particularly flavorful zip. Like any cheese fondue, it is best eaten as soon as it's ready, because the sauce will thicken as it cools.
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken broth, plus more to thin the sauce if needed
Red and yellow bell pepper strips
directions: Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and garlic powder until blended. Then whisk in the half-and-half and chicken broth. Continue to heat the mixture until it thickens and starts to bubble, about 2 minutes. Reduce the heat to low.
Gradually add the cheese, stirring until it is melted. Stir in the salsa.
Transfer the sauce to a fondue pot and set the flame to keep it warm. Add chicken broth a little at a time, as necessary, to achieve the consistency you desire.
